defaults.source: Distilled from [developer.shopware.com](https://developer.shopware.com) plus the Shopware 6.7 source, retrieved 2026-08-20. These are paid features: availability is plan-bound (Rise, Evolve, Beyond).

b2b.title: Shopware B2B
b2b.description: Shopware B2B: B2B Suite, B2B Components, employee management, quotes, order approval, migration from Suite to Components. Use when the request names Shopware B2B, a quote or order approval.
b2b.intro: Two generations coexist: the older B2B Suite and the newer B2B Components. New work goes to Components.

sales.title: Shopware sales tools
sales.description: Shopware sales tools: Sales Agent app with setup and deployment, Digital Sales Rooms with installation and config. Use when the request names Sales Agent or Digital Sales Rooms.
sales.intro: Assisted-selling products, each shipping as its own app with a separate deployment.

features.title: Shopware Commercial features
features.description: Shopware Commercial features: the Commercial bundle itself, Subscriptions, Advanced Search, Nexus. Use when the request names Shopware Subscriptions, Advanced Search or Nexus.
features.intro: Features delivered through the Commercial bundle. Each states the plan and minimum version it needs.

migration.title: Shopware Migration Assistant
migration.description: Shopware Migration Assistant: migrating shop data from Shopware 5 or another system, and writing a custom migration profile. Use when the request names the Shopware Migration Assistant.
migration.intro: Data migration into Shopware 6. A custom profile is how you support a source system it does not know.
